extraction.soa_span: AGENT: I've sent the Scope of Appointment to your email so we can go over specific plans. Can you sign it while we're on the line?

composition.summary: The agent discussed Medicare Advantage plan details without delivering the required disclaimer first. The Scope of Appointment was collected and an appointment was scheduled, but the appointment was set too soon after the SOA.
composition.coaching_note: Owen, it's important to ensure the disclaimer is read before discussing any plan benefits. In this call, the agent should have read the disclaimer before mentioning the plan details. Additionally, the appointment was scheduled too soon after the SOA, which could be seen as a compliance issue. Next time, ensure the disclaimer is read first and wait at least 24 hours before scheduling the appointment.

crm_record.next_step: Follow up with customer after 24 hours to schedule the appointment and read the disclaimer.

usage.tool_mode: disabled: two consecutive tool-call misses; JSON mode from here on
